Batch size and learning rate; CPU default, no automatic GPU selection

output: Canonical safe model_config/model_state_dict artifact, best private checkpoint published by final atomic hard-link without overwriting destination; classes, ordered sourcechannels, checkpointSHA, scaling policy, grouped train/validation provenance. No result artifact on cancellation.
